description:
Find nearby restaurants and dishes on Fantuan (饭团) for delivery or pickup. Search by restaurant name, cuisine, or dish near an address, neighborhood, or landmark. View menu item prices, ratings, estimated delivery times, and available offers. Open a restaurant in the Fantuan app or website to explore its menu and continue your order.

Available in Canada (CA), the United States (US), Australia (AU), and the United Kingdom (GB). Availability varies by location.

Ordering and payment are completed on Fantuan.
